title: Set 138

sentences.ko: 부엌 싱크대 고치는 법 좀 보려고 유튜브를 켰는데, 어쩌다 보니 두 시간 뒤에 웬 남자가 엄청 더러운 러그 빠는 영상을 보고 있더라. 싱크대는 아직도 물이 새고.
sentences.text: I only opened YouTube to see how to fix the kitchen sink, and somehow two hours later I was watching some guy clean a really dirty rug. And the sink's still leaking.

alts.text: Went on YouTube just to figure out the kitchen sink, and two hours later I'm watching some guy clean a super gross rug. Sink's still leaking, by the way.
I opened YouTube only to learn how to repair the kitchen sink, and somehow, two hours later, I was watching a man clean an extremely dirty rug. The sink is still leaking.

sentences.note: **somehow** 는 어쩌다 보니, 왜 그렇게 됐는지 모르게라는 뜻이에요. casual 의 **by the way** 는 말끝에 붙여 참고로, 그나저나 하는 느낌을 줍니다.
sentences.situation: 유튜브 보다가 시간 다 날린 얘기

sentences.ko: 거의 1년 만에 처음으로 스피닝 수업에 갔는데, 하는 내내 컨디션이 좋았거든. 근데 다음 날 아침에 일어나니까 열이 나고 온몸이 쑤시더라. 옆 사람들이 다 너무 빨리 밟으니까 내가 무리를 너무 많이 한 것 같아.
sentences.text: I went to a spin class for the first time in like a year, and I felt great the whole time, but the next morning I woke up with a fever and everything hurt. I think I pushed way too hard because everybody around me was going so fast.

alts.text: First spin class in like a year, felt amazing the whole time, then woke up the next morning with a fever and everything hurt. Pretty sure I went way too hard because everyone around me was flying.

I attended a spin class for the first time in about a year, and I felt wonderful throughout, but the following morning I woke up with a fever and ached all over. I believe I pushed myself far too hard because everyone around me was going so quickly.

sentences.note: **pushed way too hard** 는 너무 무리했다는 뜻이에요. casual 의 **went way too hard** 도 같은 뜻이고, **flying** 은 엄청 빨리 달리고 있었다는 말이에요.

sentences.ko: 그 테이블에 있던 사람이 한 명도 빠짐없이 우리한테 애는 언제 낳냐고 묻더라. 그래서 네 번째엔 그냥 애 대신 강아지 키울까 생각 중이라고 했지. 근데 알잖아, 그게 오히려 더 난리였어.
sentences.text: Every single person at that table asked us when we're having kids, so after the fourth time I just said we're thinking about getting a dog instead, which, you know, only made it worse.

alts.text: Literally everyone at that table asked when we're having kids, so after the fourth time I was like, we're kinda thinking about a dog instead. Yeah, that just made it worse.
Every person at that table asked us when we intend to have children, so after the fourth time, I simply said that we are considering getting a dog instead, which only made matters worse.

sentences.note: **made it worse** 는 상황을 더 나쁘게 만들었다는 뜻이에요. **Every single person** 은 every person 을 강조해서 한 명도 빠짐없이라는 느낌을 줍니다.
sentences.situation: 친척들 모인 자리에서 질문 공세 받은 얘기

sentences.ko: 마트 잠깐 가서 달걀이랑 우유랑 빵만 샀는데 거의 20달러가 나왔어. 진짜 예전엔 8달러쯤이었거든. 그래서 계산대 앞에 서서 대학 시절로 돌아간 것처럼 계산하고 있었다니까.
sentences.text: I ran to the store for eggs, milk, and bread, and it came to almost twenty dollars. I swear that used to be like eight bucks, so I'm standing there at the checkout doing math like I'm back in college.

alts.text: Grabbed eggs, milk, and bread real quick, and it was almost twenty bucks. I swear that was like eight bucks before, so I'm at the checkout doing math like I'm back in college.

I made a quick trip to the store for eggs, milk, and bread, and the total came to nearly twenty dollars. I am certain that used to cost about eight dollars, so I found myself at the checkout doing calculations as though I were back in college.

sentences.note: **ran to the store** 는 가게에 잠깐 다녀왔다는 뜻이에요. **came to** 는 합계가 얼마 나왔다고 할 때 쓰고, **bucks** 는 dollars 를 편하게 부르는 말이에요.

sentences.ko: 러닝화 신던 참이었는데, 그때 헤드폰을 회사에 두고 온 게 생각났어. 난 음악 없으면 못 뛰는데 그럼 나가서 뭐 해? 내일은 꼭 갈게, 약속해.
sentences.text: I was literally putting my running shoes on, but then I remembered I left my headphones at the office, and I can't run without music, so what's the point? I'll go tomorrow, I promise.

alts.text: Had my running shoes half on, then remembered my headphones are at the office. Can't run without music, so why bother? Tomorrow, I promise.

I was in the middle of putting on my running shoes when I remembered that I had left my headphones at the office, and I cannot run without music, so what would be the point? I will go tomorrow, I promise.

sentences.note: **what's the point?** 는 그래 봤자 무슨 소용이냐는 말이에요. casual 의 **why bother?** 도 굳이 뭐 하러 하냐는 비슷한 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 운동 가려다 말게 된 핑계 대기

reviewed: 4번 한국어 '가게에 잠깐 뛰어갔는데' 가 ran 을 그대로 옮긴 번역투라 '마트 잠깐 가서 샀는데' 로 고침
5번 한국어 '진짜 러닝화 신고 있었는데' 는 literally 를 그대로 옮긴 번역투라 '러닝화 신던 참이었는데' 로 고침
5번 formal 의 'there seemed to be little point' 는 원문의 반문을 약하게 눅여서 'what would be the point?' 로 바꿈
